subject: Action: final remittance schedule & VAT evidence for Zenith Analytics renewal
messages:
From: Andrew Bates <andrew.bates@zenith-analytics.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@zenith-analytics.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal invoice and VAT docs — timing for payment

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. We received Redwood's renewal packet and the PDF titled 'Zenith_Final_Invoice_20270430.pdf'. A couple quick items from procurement so we can schedule remittance from our AP team: 

- Can you confirm the wire routing (bank account + SWIFT) for the invoice?
- We need a VAT registration/certificate for Redwood to validate for EU reclaim — do you have the VAT evidence file you mentioned?
- Our PO will reference invoice 4321; can Redwood accept the PO number and issue final invoice with PO on it?

We'd like to do one consolidated wire for the full renewal amount on 2027-05-20 if everything is in order. Please advise if anything blocks that date.

Appreciate it —
Andrew
Head of Procurement | Zenith Analytics
attachments: Zenith_Final_Invoice_20270430.pdf
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Andrew Bates <andrew.bates@zenith-analytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal invoice and VAT docs — timing for payment

Hi Andrew — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers inline: 

- Wire routing: please use account shown on the attached PDF; I'll paste summary below and confirm once Treasury signs the remittance today.
- VAT evidence: attaching Redwood's EU VAT certificate (Zenith_VAT_Cert_2027.zip). That should be sufficient for reclaim.
- PO acceptance: yes, we can reissue the invoice with PO# included. If you send the PO PDF we will stamp it into the invoice and re-upload to DocuSign.

I'll coordinate the reissued invoice and confirm treasury's cut-off for a 2027-05-20 wire. Looping in Marissa for any discount/credit approvals (she owns the billing adjustments).

Karthik
Senior Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
attachments: Zenith_VAT_Cert_2027.zip
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Renewal invoice and VAT docs — timing for payment

Karthik / Grace — I reviewed the account. Zenith's renewal is for the standard committed tier; no additional credit is outstanding. Two operational notes: 

1) We can include PO# 4321 on the reissued invoice and will mark invoice status as 'final' in billing.
2) Treasury prefers wiring instructions not be copied into the invoice PDF for security; instead we'll provide a separate secure remittance stub (Zenith_Remittance_Stub.pdf) and send via encrypted DocuSign link.

If Zenith needs a gap invoice (pro-rated days) for April, let me know — looks like they paid partial usage earlier but the renewal covers the full annual commitment. Otherwise proceed to reissue.

Marissa
Head of Renewals, Redwood Inference
From: Andrew Bates <andrew.bates@zenith-analytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@zenith-analytics.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal invoice and VAT docs — timing for payment

Thanks Marissa — that works. A couple follow-ups from our side: 

- AP requires the invoice to explicitly state 'Supply of software-as-a-service services' and the VAT registration number for Redwood on the invoice itself. Can you include both?
- Our bank requires evidence of vendor registration for cross-border wires (we can accept the ZIP with VAT cert but would prefer a single-page vendor confirmation letter). Could Redwood produce a one-page vendor attestation?

If you can get the reissued invoice + vendor attestation by EOD Friday (2027-05-14), we will initiate the wire on 2027-05-20.

Best,
Andrew
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Andrew Bates <andrew.bates@zenith-analytics.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 07:58:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal invoice and VAT docs — timing for payment

Andrew — attached: reissued invoice with PO# 4321, VAT reg number on page 1, and description line updated to 'Supply of software-as-a-service services.' Also included a one-page vendor attestation (Vendor_Attestation_Zenith_20270514.pdf). Links below: 

- DocuSign (secure remittance + bank stub): https://www.docusign.com/ENVELOPEID/ABC-123-ZEN
- HubSpot deal record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/9871

We received confirmation from Treasury that they can accept a single consolidated wire on 2027-05-20. Please reply here once AP has the DocuSign link; we will mark invoice as 'paid pending' in our ledger.

Attachments: Zenith_Final_Invoice_20270514_withPO.pdf; Vendor_Attestation_Zenith_20270514.pdf; Zenith_PO_4321.pdf

Grace
Billing Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Priya Singh <priya.singh@zenith-analytics.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Andrew Bates <andrew.bates@zenith-analytics.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal invoice and VAT docs — timing for payment

Grace — received the DocuSign link and the attestation. AP will route the DocuSign-secured remittance form through our bank. One quick ask: can Redwood confirm the settled amount in EUR (we operate in EUR) and the exchange rate used if the invoice is denominated in USD? We prefer the invoice in EUR to avoid FX delays.

We'll confirm on Monday latest.

Thanks,
Priya
Senior AP Analyst, Zenith Analytics
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Priya Singh <priya.singh@zenith-analytics.com>, Andrew Bates <andrew.bates@zenith-analytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal invoice and VAT docs — timing for payment

Hi Priya / Andrew — quick confirm: Treasury has issued a EUR-denominated invoice copy (attached as Zenith_Final_Invoice_20270518_EUR.pdf) using the Bank-of-Europe spot rate on 2027-05-14; the amount is EUR 198,750. We will accept the single consolidated wire on 2027-05-20 as discussed. 

Please confirm when your bank shows the DocuSign remittance has been processed and I will close the ledger on our side. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. 

Karthik
Senior Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
attachments: Zenith_Final_Invoice_20270518_EUR.pdf
